# AWS CodeConnections repository links and sync

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend connection and host records with repository links and sync configurations.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] `CreateRepositoryLink`, `GetRepositoryLink`, `ListRepositoryLinks`, `UpdateRepositoryLink`, `DeleteRepositoryLink`
- [ ] `CreateSyncConfiguration`, `GetSyncConfiguration`, `ListSyncConfigurations`, `UpdateSyncConfiguration`, `DeleteSyncConfiguration`
- [ ] Sync status and blocker operations
- [ ] The codestar-connections service alias
- [ ] RPC v2 CBOR with a newer pinned model
- [ ] `AWS::CodeConnections::Connection`
